}}'''Sanaiye''' is a [[Domani]] [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]] who remanied loyal during the [[Tower]] split.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Sanaiye Asaheen}}

== Strength ==
[[Covarla Baldene]] obtained command in [[Dorlan]] because she was the strongest in that group of Aes Sedai. Sanaiye's strength must therefore be below that of Covarla ({{opsl|27}}).

== Activities ==
She was one of the Aes Sedai sent to kidnap [[Rand]] in [[Cairhien]]. She escaped with [[Covarla Baldene]] after [[Dumai's Wells]] battle and took refuge in the village of Dorlan.

==Trivia==
This Aes Sedai is described only in "The Wheel of Time Companion", she is never mentioned in the main books of the Wheel of Time.
